response.sql:
WITH proj AS (
  SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source,
         AVG(s.boxx * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS ratio
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux
), withavg AS (
  SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio,
         AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS source_avg
  FROM proj
)
SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - source_avg AS excess
FROM withavg
ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A spatial record with boxz = 0 has a missing (NULL) ratio, to avoid division by zero, and is ignored in the per-project average.
Projects with no valid ratio are still included, with NULL ratio and excess, so they sort last. A NULL fundflux is treated as its own group.
The funding-source average is taken over the projects' ratios, skipping projects whose ratio is NULL.
